criteria.title: Rapport
criteria.description: The operator greeted the client in the client's language and introduced themselves in the first operator reply. The bot's greeting does not satisfy this criterion.

criteria.title: Needs discovery
criteria.description: The operator used the known details and clarified what was missing before answering.
criteria.na_condition: The data was sufficient from the start, no clarification was needed.

criteria.title: Identification
criteria.description: Identity verification was confirmed before disclosing data or performing a protected action. If verification was required but not confirmed in the conversation, the answer is No.
criteria.na_condition: The request did not require identity verification (for example a general tariff question).

criteria.title: Correct and complete consultation
criteria.description: Was the client's request solved correctly and fully.
criteria.na_condition: The chat ended before the client formulated a request.

scale_steps.descriptor: All material questions closed or a correct next step given
Main question solved, minor detail missed
Part closed, a material question left open
General hint only, client still unsure how to act
No substantive answer or the key recommendation is wrong

criteria.title: Empathy and client focus
criteria.description: The operator was polite and, if the client expressed dissatisfaction or inconvenience, responded to that specific problem.

criteria.title: Dialogue management, speed, literacy
criteria.description: How clearly and consistently the operator communicated.

scale_steps.descriptor: Clear and coherent; if there was an explicit wait, operator warned
One noticeable glitch, client can still understand and continue
Client has to re-ask because of wording or ordering

criteria.title: Closing
criteria.description: The operator summarised or offered further help and said goodbye.
criteria.na_condition: The chat broke off before closing was possible.

criteria.title: Gross violations
criteria.description: Insulting the client, offering a paid service bypassing the company, or disclosing confidential information. Bypassing the company: the operator proposes the client transfer money to them personally for investing, or asks for the client's personal number for a private paid consultation. The offer alone is enough.
